rmk:
Three buzzing noises that came from an echidna I startled when I walked past it on a trail. These buzzes are best seen on a spectrogram using a window length around 300, since the oscillation speed of the buzz is fast at around 13 milliseconds. The echidna was located under a tuft of ferns and climbing grass. I couldn't see it vocalizing, so there's a chance that this wasn't a sound the echidna made, however the sound was coming right from where its head was located. When I first noticed the echidna as it startled, it made one buzz noise like this. So I took out my recorder and captured these next 3 buzzes at 0:00, 0:03, and 0:06. Then it made two more buzzes before I left. It's unclear whether these sounds were vocalizations or an artifact of its breathing, like a wheeze or snort.

I totally wanted to be the first person to post an echidna recording on Xeno-canto, so here it is folks, wahooooo!
